name: Word Bazaar
summary: A market word-search game under a striped awning: drag across letter tiles to clear each stall's list
about: A word-search game set in a lantern-lit market, with a striped awning, swinging string lights, spice sacks and a wooden tray of letter tiles. Each stall has its own list (spices, fruits, sweets, cities, cloth, tea) on a bigger board with more directions and a ticking clock, and found words fly off the board onto the shopping list. Good as a puzzle corner for a food, travel or learning site.
how: A demo hand plays on load; press Play or tap the board to open your own stall.
Drag across the letters in a straight line to circle a word; it is checked when you let go.
With the keyboard, move with the arrow keys and press Enter on the first and last letter.
Quick finds in a row raise the combo up to x5, and spare seconds at the bell become bonus points.
Six stalls grow from 8 by 8 to 12 by 12 with diagonal and backwards words, then night-market bonus rounds.
H gives a hint for 25 points, P pauses and hides the grid, R restarts; the best score is saved.
